title: temporal-2-category
description: The 2-category T(C, lambda) that packages the predicate-category C and the settling-bound lambda into a single temporal structure, generated by settling the knowledge-least valuation; its 0-cells pair a settling step with a category over C, and its 1- and 2-cells carry both predicate-axis and settling-axis movement.

symbol.description: the predicate-category C packaged with the settling-bound lambda

zero-cells.description: pairs (tau, A) with tau a settling step ordinal in lambda and A a category over C

tau.description: tau in lambda, a settling step ordinal on the settling axis

A.description: A in Cat/C, a category over the predicate-category C

one-cells.description: morphisms (f, h): (tau', A') -> (tau, A) carrying both axes

f.description: f: A' -> A in Cat/C, the predicate-axis component

h.description: h: tau -> tau' in lambda^op (i.e. tau' >= tau); settling advances forward, so morphisms run in the lambda^op direction

two-cells.description: for parallel 1-cells, a 2-cell alpha is a natural transformation alpha_f in Cat/C plus a coherence condition compatible with the h-components

predicate-axis-contravariant.description: the predicate-category C axis is contravariant in morphisms

settling-axis.description: the settling-bound lambda^op axis is covariant in settling-progression but contravariant in morphism direction

dual.description: the dualized temporal 2-category with both axes reversed via Jung-Rivieccio duality
